test_case_name: Open Search Bar and Search for a Query on Investment Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button to open the search bar on the investment page.
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field on desktop.
Click the search submit button to perform the search on desktop.
And then check that the search results are displayed for the entered query.
